title: 💠 Moments ago, another MQ-1 drone of the U.S. terrorist army was intercepted and destroyed in the skies over the Strait of Hormuz by fire from the IRGC Aerospace Force’s new advanced air defense system, under the control of the country’s integrated air defense network.
text:
💠 Moments ago, another MQ-1 drone of the U.S. terrorist army was intercepted and destroyed in the skies over the Strait of Hormuz by fire from the IRGC Aerospace Force’s new advanced air defense system, under the control of the country’s integrated air defense network."

"🔹The important point is that this advanced drone—known as the “Butcher of Kandahar” for its 20,000 flight hours over Afghanistan—was retired several years ago from the U.S. Navy and Air Force order of battle and replaced by the MQ-9. Given the destruction of a large portion of the MQ-9s, America has again been forced to use this drone."
"By God’s grace, both of them are being widely hunted by the IRGC’s new defense system."
